title: 第三章 丧尸x轮盘第四章 职业卷轴
content_zh:
，，！
在拿回消防斧后，王长乐开始查看之前弹出的提示信息消防斧白色：6（注：白色装备评分为1~10点。
评分10的白色装备，将标注为‘稀有’，附加特殊属性）产地：末日轮盘世界类别：武器耐久：1920攻击力：5~9】装备需求：力量3点可使用，力量6点可灵活使用简介：这是一把粗制的流水线产品，虽然简陋但却很实用，价格：800乐园币，（此物品为几率拾取道具，无法带出衍生世界）握着手中的消防斧，王长乐心里很是满足。
虽然他力量还达不到灵活使用的程度，但他试了试手感也还算不错，就是在劈砍的时候有点收不住力。
不论是用来破门开锁，还是用来斩首开道，这消防斧都算是极为实用了。
……乐园的提示，让王长乐明白如果他要获得足够的力量的话，那么乐园币的获取绝对不可或缺。
忽然，外面震耳欲聋的轰鸣声停了。
原本昏迷的服务员，面容以肉眼可见的速度枯萎，额头还长出了一颗灰色的结晶，浑身散发出恶臭。
这种恶臭他很熟悉，这是尸体腐烂后发出的气味。
“愿你下辈子，投个好胎！”
手起斧落，一颗大好头颅被砸的稀烂。
世界之源是世界结算时，重要的评定要素，也是决定他在这个世界能获得的最终奖励的关键。
一只丧尸的世界之源连001都没有，一瞬间就否定了刷分的可能。
王长乐眼睛一眯，看来计划要有所改变才行！
收起白色宝箱，他拿起餐车上的餐刀，将头颅上的灰色结晶挖了下来。
将灰色结晶收入印记空间，王长乐知道这意味着，他又少了一项世界收获。
‘乐园’还真是一点漏洞都不给钻啊！
不过王长乐发现这种一级丧尸的身体，比正常人的身体防御还要差。
没有开封的斧头剁下去的手感，就像是在剁一颗饱满的西瓜。
1级魔晶虽价值低廉，但却是转动轮盘的必需品，若要完成主线任务，他需要大量的魔晶，以及轮盘。

收起了魔晶，王长乐开始研究起了印记空间，不断地把消防斧和餐刀收进去又取出来。
多次的试验，让他发现几乎所有物品都可以轻松的放进印记空间，只要是双手能接触到且体积不超过2立方！
这个信息对他之后的战斗很关键，合理利用一切手段，是生存下来并获取胜利重要素质。
王长乐每次取用几乎无消耗，意念一动就能从印记空间里面取出自己想要的东西，方便且快捷。
对印记空间有了认识之后，他有感觉这个能力在战斗中运用得好，会有着意想不到的收获。
王长乐选择了‘是’，宝箱随之开启，一瓶淡粉色的药剂落在手中。
不完全免疫药剂产地:末日轮盘世界类型:消耗品品质：白色6分。
效果：饮用后，可免疫接下来受到的丧尸攻击产生的病毒感染。
33价格：500乐园币（此为规则物品，可以带出衍生世界）王长乐第一时间就喝了下去，口感有点类似发酸了的美乃滋。
至于带出世界什么的，那首先得活下来才行！
从复活到治愈伤势，再到数据化个人信息，最后到传送世界开启宝箱，王长乐一次又一次感受到了轮回乐园的神奇。
亲身体验和从书本上看到的感觉，是不一样的！
content_en:
,,!
After getting back the fire ax, Wang Changle started to check the pop-up message. Fire ax white: 6 (Note: White equipment scores from 1 to 10 points.
White equipment with a score of 10 will be marked as 'rare' with special attributes attached) Place of Origin: Doomsday Roulette World Category: Weapon Durability: 1920 Attack Power: 5~9] Equipment Requirements: Strength 3 points can be used, Strength 6 points can be used flexibly Introduction: This is a crude assembly line product, although simple but very practical, Price: 800 Paradise Coins, (This item is a chance to pick up a prop and cannot be taken out of the derivative world) Holding the fire ax in his hand, Wang Changle was very satisfied.
Although his strength was not yet flexible enough to use, he felt pretty good when he tried it, but he just couldn't hold back his strength when chopping.
Whether it is used to break doors and unlock doors, or behead people to clear a way, this fire ax is extremely practical.
...Paradise's reminder made Wang Changle understand that if he wanted to gain enough power, obtaining Paradise Coins was absolutely indispensable.
Suddenly, the deafening roar outside stopped.
The originally unconscious waiter's face withered at a speed visible to the naked eye, a gray crystal grew on his forehead, and his whole body exuded a foul odor.
He was familiar with this stench. It was the smell of decomposing corpses.
"May you have a good pregnancy in your next life!"
The ax fell from his hand, and his big head was smashed to pieces.
The source of the world is an important evaluation factor when settling the world, and it is also the key to determining the final reward he can obtain in this world.
A zombie's World Source doesn't even have 001, which instantly negates the possibility of gaining points.
Wang Changle narrowed his eyes, it seems that the plan needs to be changed!
Putting away the white treasure box, he picked up the knife on the dining cart and dug out the gray crystals on his head.
Putting the gray crystal into the imprint space, Wang Changle knew that this meant that he had lost another world harvest.
‘Paradise’ really doesn’t have any loopholes to exploit!
However, Wang Changle discovered that the body of this first-level zombie had worse body defense than a normal person.
The feeling of chopping with an unopened ax is like chopping a plump watermelon.
Although level 1 magic crystals are of low value, they are necessary for spinning the roulette wheel. To complete the main mission, he needs a large amount of magic crystals and roulette wheels.
After putting away the magic crystal, Wang Changle began to study the imprint space, constantly putting in and taking out the fire ax and table knife.
After many experiments, he discovered that almost all items can be easily placed into the imprinted space, as long as they can be touched by both hands and the volume does not exceed 2 cubic meters!
This information is crucial to his subsequent battles. Proper use of all means is an important quality for surviving and winning.
Wang Changle consumes almost nothing every time he takes it. He can take out what he wants from the imprinted space with just a thought, which is convenient and fast.
After getting to know the imprinted space, he felt that if this ability was used well in battle, it would yield unexpected gains.
Wang Changle chose 'yes', and the treasure chest opened, and a bottle of light pink potion fell into his hand.
Incomplete immunity potion Origin: Doomsday Roulette World Type: Consumable Quality: White 6 points.
Effect: After drinking, you can be immune to viral infections caused by subsequent zombie attacks.
33 Price: 500 Paradise Coins (This is a regular item and can be brought out to a derivative world) Wang Changle drank it immediately. The taste was a bit like sour mayonnaise.
As for taking it out of the world, you have to survive first!
From resurrection to healing injuries, to digitizing personal information, and finally to teleporting to the world to open a treasure chest, Wang Changle felt the magic of Samsara Paradise again and again.
The feeling of experiencing it in person is different from reading it in books!
